title: The owner's booking list names the service, shows past sessions, and can mark a no-show, reschedule or add a booking

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: BookingOwnerList shows name, time, note and answers, but not which service was booked (listSpaceBookings never maps service_type_id), only upcoming rows, and Cancel is the only action. rescheduleBooking already allows an admin; there is no control for it, no way to add a booking taken by phone, and no no-show mark to feed the CRM risk flags (lib/spaces/contact-risk.ts already scores no_show).

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
